messages.subject: Pressure washer booking dates
messages.body:
Hi,

Our site schedule shifted and the dates on the petrol pressure washer booking won't work anymore. Can we push it back? Let me know what you have available.

Regards,
Routakallion Infra Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pressure washer booking dates
messages.body:
Got your message. I'll check what's available for the pressure washer and come back to you with the options.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pressure washer booking dates
messages.body:
Thanks Petri.

Separate question while I have you. We got the invoice for the diamond floor saw and something on it looks off. Could someone take a look? I can forward it if you need.

Routakallion Infra Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pressure washer booking dates
messages.body:
Hi there,

Sure, I'll pull up the diamond floor saw invoice. If you have the invoice number handy that would help speed things up.

Kind regards,
Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Pressure washer booking dates
messages.body:
One more thing. We're done with the 10m scissor lift and need to arrange the return. Can you come pick it up from site or do we bring it to the depot?

Routakallion Infra Oy

messages.subject: Damage waiver claim - concrete mixer RB-20263768
messages.body:
We need to make a claim on the Damage Waiver Cover for the 140L concrete mixer, rental RB-20263768. We were doing a large pour and ran the unit continuously well past its rated working limit. The motor seized and the mixer is completely out of action. Repair cost is 180 euros.

We had the Damage Waiver on this booking so we'd like it covered. Let us know how to proceed.

Nostopalvelu Karjula Oy

messages.subject: Claim on damage waiver - RB-20262632
messages.body:
Hi,

I'd like to claim on the Damage Waiver Cover for the diamond floor saw I rented, reference RB-20262632. I was cutting through a garage floor and went past the stated maximum cutting depth on a few passes. The blade cracked and the guard got damaged too. I've been quoted 260 euros to fix it.

I paid for the waiver so this should be covered, right?

Thanks,
Ville Junttila

messages.subject: Re: Claim on damage waiver - RB-20262632
messages.body:
Hi Ville,

Thanks for letting us know. I've logged your claim and will look into it. We'll be in touch once we've gone through the details.

Best regards,
Outi Vahakangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Claim on damage waiver - RB-20262632
messages.body:
Thanks Outi.

While I'm waiting on that, do you have a 20kVA diesel generator available for hire? Got a job coming up where I'll need one. Let me know what dates work.

Cheers,
Ville

messages.subject: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hello,

We want to raise a query about an invoice from a rental earlier in the year. We understand there is no deadline for disputing invoices, so we are bringing this up now. There are charges on it that we believe are incorrect and we would like them reviewed.

Please advise how to proceed.

Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hello,

Noted, I'll look into this. Could you send the invoice number so I can pull it up?

Regards,
Outi Vahakangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Outi,

This is separate and urgent. One of our operators got an electric shock from the generator we have on hire from you. He touched the casing and got shocked. The unit needs to be taken out of service immediately. Please call me about this as soon as you can.

Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting this. I've noted the incident and passed it on. Someone will be in contact with you shortly.

Regards,
Outi Vahakangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Invoice query
messages.body:
Back on invoices. We also have a question about the invoice for the 1-tonne mini dumper rental. Can someone check that one as well?

Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy
